steps.body: Teen numerals take two marks: a 1 in front for the full ten, and a second digit counting the extras. 14 reports ten-and-four.
steps.narration: Teen numerals take two marks: a 1 in front for the full ten, and a second digit counting the extras. 14 reports ten-and-four.

widget.prompt: Fourteen is a full ten plus 4 more. Tap 4 dots to show the 'more' part.

commonCounts.feedback: 0 leaves 4 dots still missing. Continue until the frame shows exactly 4.
3 leaves 1 dot still missing. Continue until the frame shows exactly 4.
5 adds 1 too many. Remove the extra so the frame shows exactly 4.

widget.missFeedback: Tap the dots one at a time. Stop when the frame shows exactly 4 — that's the 'more' part of 14.
widget.successFeedback: Ten and 4 — the numeral 14 writes those two pieces side by side.

predict.prompt: Writing fourteen — what does the front 1 stand for?
predict.reveal: Position gives the digit its job: in front of another digit, 1 reports a complete ten.

cml.actionGoal: Link the written numeral to the exact amount it names for kcw write teens.
invariants: A numeral is a written promise about an amount: it records the last word of a careful count, position gives each digit its job, and the promise survives any change of objects or arrangement — the anchor for kcw write teens.
misconceptions: Treating numerals as decorations, reading digit pairs without position, or matching a numeral to roughly rather than exactly its amount.

options.label: One loose one
options.feedback: The front 1 is not a loose one; its place gives it a value of ten.

widget.prompt: Start at 10 and count on 4. Tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: 13 stops one complete hop too soon. Continue the final 1-unit hop to reach 14.
15 goes one complete hop too far. Count just 4 hops from 10 to land on 14.

widget.missFeedback: Count 4 on from 10: you land on 14.
widget.successFeedback: 10 and 4 more is 14 — the teen numeral writes exactly that: 1 ten, 4 ones.
widget.lowFeedback: Short of the landing — all 4 counts past ten are needed to reach 14.
widget.highFeedback: Past the landing — the count-on stops after 4 numbers, on 14.

options.feedback: 20 promises more dots than the group holds; the count stops at 19.
18 promises fewer dots than the group holds; the count reaches 19.
21 promises more dots than the group holds; the count stops at 19.
Correct — the numeral 19 is the written name for a group of exactly 19.
